sections.title: Core Foundations & Conceptual Framework
sections.content:
• **Philosophical School**: Propounded **Shuddhadvaita** (Pure Non-dualism), asserting that the world is not an illusion (Maya) but a manifestation of Brahman.
• **Theological Focus**: Centered on **Pushtimarg** (Path of Grace), where divine grace (Pushti) is the primary means of salvation, rather than asceticism or knowledge.
• **Deity Worship**: Devotion directed toward **Shrinathji** (a form of Krishna), emphasizing 'Seva' (service) and 'Bhakti' (devotion) as the highest forms of spiritual practice.
• **Key Metric**: The **Ashtachhap** (eight seals) poets, established by his son Vitthalnath, codified the devotional literature and music of the sect.

items.definition: The doctrine of 'Pure Non-dualism'. Unlike Advaita, it posits that the world is a real transformation of Brahman, not an illusion.
The eight disciples of Vallabhacharya and his son Vitthalnath, who were master poets. Surdas is the most famous among them.
The traditional devotional music performed in the temples (Havelis) of the Pushtimarg sect.

items.title: Major Applications / Initiatives
items.content:
• **Braj Bhakti**: Established the worship of Shrinathji at Mount Govardhan, making it the epicenter of the sect.
• **Literary Contribution**: Authored 'Anubhashya' (commentary on Brahma Sutras) and 'Subodhini' (commentary on Bhagavata Purana).

items.title: Challenges & Way Forward
items.content:
• **Challenges**: Balancing the ritualistic 'Seva' with the original philosophical simplicity of the Bhakti movement.
• **Solutions**: Preservation of the oral traditions of Haveli Sangeet and scholarly study of the Sanskrit texts.

items.title: Mnemonic for Retention
items.content:
• **Memory Acronym**: 'V-S-P' (Vallabha - Shuddhadvaita - Pushtimarg).
• **Decoded Meaning**: Vallabhacharya taught Shuddhadvaita, which leads to the Pushtimarg (Path of Grace).

upscNotes.content: Examiner Trap: UPSC often confuses Shuddhadvaita (Vallabhacharya) with Vishishtadvaita (Ramanuja). Remember: Ramanuja = Qualified Non-dualism; Vallabhacharya = Pure Non-dualism.

Mains Value Addition: Use the term 'Bhakti-centric Humanism' to describe how Vallabhacharya made spirituality accessible to the common man through the concept of 'Grace' rather than complex Vedic rituals.

keyTakeaways: Vallabhacharya founded the Shuddhadvaita school of Vedanta.
Pushtimarg emphasizes divine grace over asceticism.
The Ashtachhap poets were instrumental in popularizing Krishna-bhakti in the vernacular.
